data.name: Paulraj
data.gender_notes: Paulraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Paulraj is derived from two Sanskrit words, 'Paul' meaning sun and 'Raj' meaning ruler. Thus, this name signifies the one who is a ruler of the sun or a sun king. The name Paulraj carries the meaning “Sun Ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu. Parents who choose Paulraj usually hope their child will grow to embody sun ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Paulraj is a powerful name that represents the divine energy of the sun and the ability to rule one's own life and destiny.
data.etymology: Paulraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Paulraj total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Paulraj is also known as Bhaskara II and is considered one of the greatest mathematicians and astronomers in Indian history. He made important contributions to the fields of algebra, trigonometry, and calculus, and his works influenced European mathematics.
